categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies `src/torcontrol.cpp`, which manages the Tor control port integration covered by P2P.
categories.rationale: Stops unconditional log pollution on default-configured nodes caused by a recent regression. As described in the PR and issue #36691, failed Tor reconnection attempts log unconditional warnings (around 18 lines per hour) when Tor is not running, and demoting them back to debug level cleans up node logs without affecting P2P operation.
